metadata.technology_specification: Discrete Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) with GDDR6 memory
metadata.technology_reasoning: Discrete GPUs with dedicated GDDR6 memory are the industry standard for high-performance graphics cards as of 2024, representing the majority of the market in gaming, professional visualization, and AI workloads due to their superior speed and memory bandwidth compared to integrated solutions.

components.reasoning: The core silicon die that performs all graphics processing tasks; universally present and the defining component of any GPU.
Discrete GPUs typically use dedicated GDDR6 memory for high-bandwidth data storage, procured as separate memory ICs and essential for performance.
The substrate that hosts the GPU, memory, VRMs, and other components; always a distinct, manufactured assembly.
Critical power delivery components ensuring stable voltage to the GPU and memory; typically separate power electronics on the PCB.
Most discrete GPUs include an active cooling system to dissipate heat; procured as a separate thermal assembly.
Standard connector for interfacing with the motherboard; separate component soldered onto the PCB.

components.component: VRAM Controller and Memory Interface Chips
components.reasoning: Integral for memory management if separate from GPU die; sometimes integrated but often distinct chips on high-end boards.
